title: OHLGT-L03 read-back summary total outstanding with non-zero, differing fee and penalty
_note: Parity vector transcribing the OHLGT-L03 (loan 12) loan-detail summary read-back. This is the capture F-2026-09-09 asked for: all FOUR outstanding buckets are non-zero, and the fee and penalty buckets DIFFER so a term-swap defect cannot survive. request.summary.principal_outstanding_minor=10000000 is the capture summary's "principalOutstanding":100000.0; interest_outstanding_minor=661853 is "interestOutstanding":6618.53; fee_outstanding_minor=10000 is "feeChargesOutstanding":100.0; penalty_outstanding_minor=5700 is "penaltyChargesOutstanding":57.0. expect.summary_total_minor=10677553 is the capture summary's "totalOutstanding":106775.53 in minor units, the total Fineract derived from those buckets (total_outstanding_derived). The five summary vectors that predate this one all carry fee = penalty = 0, where dropping either term is unobservable; here dropping the fee bucket reads 10000 short and dropping the penalty bucket reads 5700 short, so the vector kills loan-wrong-summary-drops-fee and loan-wrong-summary-drops-penalty. Nothing was computed by this promotion; the buckets and the total are transcriptions of the oracle's derived columns.

provenance.note: request.summary buckets and expect.summary_total_minor are transcribed from the "summary" block of the committed capture loan-12-raw.json; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan. The request that CREATED OHLGT-L03 is committed byte-stable alongside the response in the same capture directory (req/loan-OHLGT-L03-submit.json, amount tokens 100 and 57 written as integers so they survive the POST /charges binary-double round trip).
